# Bangle by Choice

> Bangle by Choice is a Hyderabad-based online store for bangle and jewellery-making materials, delivering across India.

## Main collections
- Silk thread materials
- Kundan stones
- Jewellery-making tools and supplies
- Imitation jewellery materials
- Ready-to-dispatch craft products

## Shopping and support
- Website: https://www.banglebychoice.in
- Product catalog: https://www.banglebychoice.in/#catalog
- Shipping: https://www.banglebychoice.in/help/shipping
- Returns: https://www.banglebychoice.in/help/returns
- Contact: https://www.banglebychoice.in/help/contact
- WhatsApp: +91 95536 55562

Product prices and availability should be checked on the relevant product page. Orders are confirmed through WhatsApp.
